subject: National literals
notes: cite.py --check 8.3.3.5.3 "Two contiguous quotation symbol characters matching the quotation symbol used in the opening delimiter" -> OK (rule 3). STR_BODY lexes '""' inside a quote-delimited body and '\'\'' inside an apostrophe-delimited one; Decode collapses the doubled OPENING delimiter only. Probe p1: N"A""B" -> A"B (LENGTH 3), N'A''B' LENGTH 3, VALUE N'a''b' -> a'b, and the non-matching quote N'A"B' is ordinary content (LENGTH 3). Second sentence (same coded character set representation as the opening quote): only the basic quotation mark/apostrophe are delimiters, so a doubled pair is necessarily in the opening delimiter's representation; a full-width quote is plain content. No spec-derived test pins the doubled delimiter inside N".." - test-needed. [editions as adjudicated: COBOL-2002, COBOL-2014, COBOL-2023 (national literals are a COBOL-2002 introduction; absent from COBOL-85, where the construct is rejected COBOL0900 via Constructs.NationalData2002)]
